Gifted: Anchor Point.name: Gifted: Anchor Point
Gifted: Anchor Point.description:
🧬 Anchor Point, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Hold up to three anchors, always sensing each, and snap to any within your city district, arriving at rest whatever your speed, so a snap ends a fall.
📈 Training adds strike-and-snap, sending a touched person to safety, delivering a villain to a police van, tagging a car, shuttling people from fires and up to six anchors.
⚠️ Only you and what you wear and carry make the trip: a grip on you is left holding air, and an anchor someone stands on puts you down beside them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as each snap leaves you dizzy and half-deaf for a breath.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Anchor Point.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Anchor Point family): Scale: a bare palm held a moment on a fixed spot plants an anchor. New adult user: up to three, each lasting about a day, always sensing direction and distance; focus snaps them to any anchor within about 2 km, arriving at rest, so a snap ends a fall. Carrying or sending others, moving or extra anchors need techniques. Limits: only body and gear go; grippers hold air; a chained rope or cuff stays, wrenching the wrist. Anchors: non-living fixed spots only, lost if moved. Occupied: arrive beside them; sealed, flooded or buried: snap fails. No snap unconscious or panicking. Quirk Strain: light: snap, strike-and-recall; moderate: send or carry one, tag a vehicle; heavy: shuttle several, three-sided rush; severe: signature throw, six anchors. Type: Emitter. Law: snapping into a locked home or office is trespass; warrantless anchoring of a stranger's car to tail it is stalking.
